do_if.value: not this.ship.isplayerowned or ($job != 2 and $job != 5) or not @player.entity.$vgo_objects.{this.ship}.$vgo_taxi_delivered or @player.entity.$vgo_objects.{this.ship}.$vgo_taxi_completed_service != $job or @player.entity.$vgo_objects.{this.ship}.$vgo_taxi_completed_id le 0 or @player.entity.$vgo_objects.{this.ship}.$vgo_taxi_delivered_count le 0 or @player.entity.$vgo_objects.{this.ship}.$vgo_taxi_delivered_count gt 10 or @player.entity.$vgo_objects.{this.ship}.$vgo_passengers.count

$job == 5 and (@player.entity.$vgo_objects.{this.ship}.$vgo_tour_booked_stops le 0 or @player.entity.$vgo_objects.{this.ship}.$vgo_tour_trip.count lt @player.entity.$vgo_objects.{this.ship}.$vgo_tour_booked_stops or @player.entity.$vgo_objects.{this.ship}.$vgo_tour_sectors.count lt @player.entity.$vgo_objects.{this.ship}.$vgo_tour_minsectors)

set_value.name: player.entity.$vgo_objects.{this.ship}.$vgo_status
set_value.exact: 'Passenger service: invalid booked fare; payment retained for diagnosis'

debug_text.text: 'GO passenger payment: ship=%1 service=%2 contract=%3 owed=%4 actual=%5 received=%6 total=%7 balance_before=%8 balance_after=%9'.[this.ship.debugname,$job,player.entity.$vgo_objects.{this.ship}.$vgo_taxi_completed_id,$remaining,$paid,player.entity.$vgo_objects.{this.ship}.$vgo_taxi_fare_received,player.entity.$vgo_objects.{this.ship}.$vgo_taxi_fare_total,$moneybefore,player.money]

set_value.name: player.entity.$vgo_objects.{this.ship}.$vgo_status
set_value.exact: 'Passenger fare pending: ' + player.entity.$vgo_objects.{this.ship}.$vgo_taxi_fare_received.formatted.default + '/' + player.entity.$vgo_objects.{this.ship}.$vgo_taxi_fare_total.formatted.default + ' received; retrying the unpaid balance'

write_to_logbook.title: 'Galactic Occupations: passenger fare pending'
write_to_logbook.text: this.ship.knownname + ': passengers delivered; ' + (player.entity.$vgo_objects.{this.ship}.$vgo_taxi_fare_total - player.entity.$vgo_objects.{this.ship}.$vgo_taxi_fare_received).formatted.default + ' still owed. No paid marker set; retry in one minute.'

do_if.value: not player.entity.$vgo_rep_times.{$faction}? or player.entity.$vgo_rep_times.{$faction} le player.age

write_to_logbook.title: 'Galactic Occupations: passenger fare paid'
write_to_logbook.text: this.ship.knownname + ': received ' + player.entity.$vgo_objects.{this.ship}.$vgo_taxi_fare_received.formatted.default + ' for ' + player.entity.$vgo_objects.{this.ship}.$vgo_taxi_delivered_count + ' passengers. Contract ' + player.entity.$vgo_objects.{this.ship}.$vgo_taxi_completed_id + ' paid in full.'
